creations.title: ACE Wind Now
creations.creator: charlie9578
creations.summary: A calm community turbine card showing the latest 60-second mean power and wind speed, with a timestamp and clear stale or unavailable states.
creations.imageAlt: ACE Wind Now card with a green turbine illustration, 1,082 kW mean power, 7 m/s mean wind speed, a recent-reading badge and the 1 October 2026, 14:39 BST timestamp.
creations.dataUse: Uses ACE wec-1 wecstd latest 60-second mean power and wind speed; refreshes every minute; marks readings over five minutes old stale and retains the last reading if the API is unavailable.
